name: Tokuda Issei
source:
The school’s student council Vice President. He’s been close to Iroha ever since their elementary days, and is now dating her. With his calm personality, he’s a boy who is loved by everyone. Born and raised in a single father household, he thinks of Iroha as his family. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=931607]Getchu[/url]]
